role: Emits a Zod runtime catalog, a React registry, and flat Spec payloads; styling delegated to the emitted React components
realises: Compiles component contracts into a typed defineCatalog module (Zod per component, invalidPropCombinations as .superRefine), a starter defineRegistry binding each entry to the already-emitted react/ tree, and one flat {root, elements, state} Spec per composition and instance example. SPIKE STATUS (DirectedEdges/spectacular#961): authored from the json-render spike; rows carry basis: implementation, verified by the spike's gates against @json-render/core 0.23.2.
note: This platform transmits the prop and composition surfaces, like a2ui, with three deliberate divergences from that sibling binding: accessibility-convention props stay ordinary props (json-render has no accessibility envelope); enum values normalize to the enumCase contract (the registry binds to the React components, whose unions spell normalized values — a payload in spec casing would fail both); and declarative constraints live only in the catalog's Zod (no runtime checks surface — the component schema is the enforcement point, since the SDK's composed zodSchema() rebuilds prop objects and drops refinements). Styles are not read except through the promotion table; element visibility (styles.visible: false) lowers to the Spec's native visible: false.

surfaces.note: Catalog and registry are catalog-wide; Specs are per composition and per instance example. The states fork (statesToContract), placeholder lowering ({Placeholder} → {$state} + seeded state), two-way value/constrained binding ({$bindState: /<id>/<prop>}), template lowering (repeat: {statePath} + one template child with $bindItem), and role/action dispatch (on: {event: {action, params}}) follow the same rules the a2ui binding declares, in this target's idioms.

boolean.notes: A boolean classified as a browser-managed state concept never reaches the catalog.

string.realises: z.string().nullable().optional(), constraints as .min/.max/.regex; required constraints drop the widening
string.notes: The SDK's validate() is binding-tolerant: a {$state} or {$bindState} object passes a plain string schema.

enum.realises: z.enum([...]) with values normalized to the enumCase contract
enum.notes: Normalized because the registry binds to the React contracts; payload values normalize identically.

number.realises: z.number() with .min/.max; numeric enums as literal unions; never null-widened
number.notes: Mirrors the React contract's scalarType, which spells numbers plain — the registry spread requires the two to agree.

slot.realises: catalog slots list ('default' for the default slot, named slots verbatim); payload children / slots record; a sole named slot renders as React children, the way the scaffolds consume it

image.notes: Same loss the a2ui binding declares for the kind.

object.realises: z.object of its members, each by its own scalar kind

statesToContract.resolution: A prop whose every state concept resolves to omit is removed from the Zod props object and from every emitted element.
statesToContract.partial: Omission is all-or-nothing per prop: one kept concept and it transmits whole.
statesToContract.notes: Identical to the a2ui binding's rule, in this target's artifacts.

constraintLowering.resolution: Expressible forbidden configurations compile to one .superRefine body on the component's Zod props, each failing with a message naming the combination.
constraintLowering.partial: A combination naming an omitted prop drops; the per-component schema is the enforcement point — the composed catalog.zodSchema() rebuilds prop objects and drops refinements (measured, @json-render/core 0.23.2).

valueBinding.resolution: The value convention's prop and any constrained prop emit as {$bindState: /<id>/<prop>}, seeded verbatim in top-level state; the registry wires them through useBoundProp and composes the change event with emit().
valueBinding.partial: Only configured props bind; an unconfigured value prop leaves neither binding nor seed.

actionDispatch.resolution: A declared behavior concept emits on: {<event>: {action, params}} with the ACTION_SPECS payload plan; the catalog's actions dictionary carries every vocabulary concept with typed params; role activation obligations wire the registry's handlers to emit(<event>).
actionDispatch.partial: A role-derived-only component emits no on binding — an ActionBinding must name a catalog action, and there is no declared behavior to name.

container.realises: a configured container primitive, via the promotion table

text.realises: a configured text primitive, via the promotion table

glyph.realises: a configured glyph primitive, via the promotion table

instance.realises: a Spec node whose type is the instanced catalog symbol

roles.$comment: Roles wire the registry (activation handlers → emit) and gate dispatch; semantics live in the React components the registry binds.

literal.realises: the element's prop value; a whole-value `{Placeholder}` lowers to a `{$state}` read with seeded state

mixed.notes: The mixed sentinel states variance, not a value; nothing is emitted for it.

token.notes: Tokens resolve inside the React components the registry binds.

theme.notes: Theme selection is the host application's.

binding.notes: A `$binding` names an intra-component relation the React implementation already realises.

conditional.notes: Conditional styling is the React implementation's.

slotContent.realises: the fill's triplet in the flat element map (children / slots record); a repeated fill lowers to `repeat` + a `$bindItem` template

subcomponent.notes: A SubcomponentRef `instanceOf` is not a string symbol; the element drops with a warning. Flattened subcomponent names resolve normally.

elementType.notes: External element-type definitions do not transmit.

image.realises: the registry reference as a string the host resolves
image.notes: Same loss the image prop kind declares.
